content.short: Sundial is a hybrid Layer-2 solution bridging Bitcoin and Cardano to enable native BTC staking and liquidity.
content.description: Sundial is an innovative hybrid Layer-2 (L2) protocol specifically designed to create an application layer between the Bitcoin and Cardano ecosystems. By utilizing an Optimistic Rollup architecture, Sundial unlocks the vast liquidity of Bitcoin, allowing users to stake BTC and participate in Cardano DeFi without centralized bridges. The platform prioritizes institutional-grade security and compliance, leveraging Cardano's UTXO model to protect digital assets. Sundial aims to bridge the market gap for dormant Bitcoin, onboarding new users and liquidity to the decentralized economy.
content.meta: Sundial is a hybrid Cardano Layer-2 solution that bridges Bitcoin liquidity and enables BTC staking. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
